findings.rationale: Accepted at the generation cap (depth-0 adjudication) and folded: admission reads qualification-metrics.json (model-dyno.qualification-metrics.v2); before any row is used the whole document passes validateMetrics with semantics on and each record passes validateRecord; any entry failure rejects the whole document; controls well-formed-with-one-bad-qualification-entry and unsupported-schema-version (plan lines 24, 49, 110).

Accepted and folded: the wire digest is described as cache-alteration detection only against the recorded expected digest, with no publisher authentication; transport protection is the HTTPS boundary; a successful substitution is the same accepted auto risk as a compromised publisher, bounded by the local invariants and confirm/off (section 8 threat list, lines 115-126).

Accepted and folded: the expected digest is the recorded content-addressed cache identity; every admission read rehashes the cached wire bytes and compares; mismatch rejects the whole document loudly; distinguished from computing a new identity at first download; control cache-bytes-tampered-after-download (lines 49, 110, 120, 126).
Accepted and folded: the P4b row carries its owner label (line 112).

Accepted and folded: the remaining P5/P6 negative controls have short names (feed-lifts-local-strike, feed-overwrites-local-evidence, pin-wins-over-feed, confirmation-cannot-bypass-invariants, import-duplicate-record; lines 109-110).
